newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes down after bullish week.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes down after bullish week.

text.p: The Czech PX50 closed down 0.82 percent to 532.9 on Friday as a widely predicted round of profit taking hit two of the index's most heavily weighted issues, Komercni Banka and SPT Telecom.

SPT fell 90 crowns, 2.1 percent, to 4,290 and Komercni dropped 80 crowns, 4.1 percent, to 1,850. Despite the falls, SPT remains up 12.6 percent on the week while Komercni closed the week up 13.1 percent.
Elsewhere, power utility CEZ posted moderate gains, rising 11 crowns to 930. Ceska Sporitelna was up four crowns to 271, and Investicni Banka was unchanged on 224.
Turnover was slightly lower but remained relatively heavy at 1.1 billion crowns.
